about_the_game:
14: Overmind is a cosmic survival experience where you confront the unknown reaches of space. Prepare for epic adventures in a universe filled with secrets, resources, and perilous threats.

A Dynamic Open World with Unique Biomes
Each biome presents a fresh challenge. Environments radically shift gameplay, introducing unique mechanics and hazards. Embark on a journey where every biome isn’t just a setting but an evolving threat or opportunity.

An Intuitive Crafting System
Discover rare resources from anomalous zones and use cutting-edge technologies to forge your path to survival. Each crafting process is enhanced with innovative tools and visually stunning effects, making resource gathering both engaging and satisfying.

Unpredictable Threats from the Fifth Dimension
Anomalous zones distort the very laws of physics, complicating your movement and navigation. But the true danger lies with fractals — enigmatic entities from the fifth dimension. Each encounter with these beings requires a distinct strategy, as they bend the rules of time and space, creating dynamic, unpredictable challenges.

Deep and Intriguing Storyline

Uncover the secrets of the anomalous cosmos and the mysteries surrounding your own crew. What led to the catastrophe? How did you end up within the anomaly? How will you survive, and what is the purpose behind it all?

Inspired by the legendary games of the survival genre, we’ve crafted Overmind to combine beloved mechanics with innovative twists, ensuring an atmospheric experience that captivates from the very first moment and lingers long after.

Demo version

The demo version is limited to two locations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX570 / Intel ARC A380
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX6700 / Intel ARC A750
  • Storage: 9 GB available space

short_description: You’re alone in space. Your goal is to survive. Utilize futuristic technologies to transform an abandoned base into a safe haven. Explore new worlds, build your own spaceship, and become the master of the stars! Your story begins in Overmind.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
